html:
Basketball is a team sport in which two sides of five players try to score by throwing a ball through a hoop at each end of a court. It was invented in December 1891 by James Naismith at a YMCA training school in Springfield, Massachusetts.

Naismith, a Canadian physical education teacher, was asked to create an indoor game to keep students active during the cold New England winter. He wrote thirteen basic rules and nailed two peach baskets to the balcony of the gym. The first game had nine players a side and ended 1 to 0. Someone had to climb up to get the ball out after each score, until open nets came in.

The game spread fast through the YMCA network, to colleges and then abroad, carried by YMCA workers and American missionaries. It became an Olympic sport in 1936, at Berlin, where Naismith watched. The professional league that became the National Basketball Association (NBA) began in 1946. Its teams were all white until 1950, when the first Black players joined. Black stars later came to define the game.

Basketball is now one of the most played sports in the world, popular from the Philippines and China to Lithuania, Serbia and Argentina. Like jazz and Hollywood, it is a piece of American culture that became global in the 20th century, and NBA players today come from dozens of countries.
sum: Basketball is a team sport in which two sides of five players try to score by throwing a ball through a hoop at each end of a court. It was invented in December 1891 by James Naismith at a YMCA training school in Springfield, Massachusetts.
